My dear [Miss Smith](/person/263)
Here are two chapters to make up for the having missed one out last time. I was obliged to do so, for I had the wrong proof with me when I was from home, and had to wait till I could get at the proof of the first.
I believe I told you of our change of house.

Our direction now is Elderfield, Otterbourn, [sic] Winchester

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: In envelope addressed to Miss Smith/ 8 Wellington Road/ Old Charlton/ SE and postmarked Winchester 11 September 1863 and London SE 12 September 1863.
